blessings.name: Shield Spark
blessings.desc: Dashing strikes nearby enemies for judgment damage.

blessings.name: Word Against Them
blessings.desc: Your crescent special marks enemies. Marked enemies take +20% damage.

blessings.name: Indictment
blessings.desc: Marked enemies take an additional +25% damage.

blessings.name: Opened Doors
blessings.desc: Room exits reveal an additional path.

raphael.name: Raphael
raphael.title: Healer of the Wound of the World

blessings.name: Balm of the Road
blessings.desc: Heal 8 health after clearing each room.

blessings.name: Clean Hands
blessings.desc: Corruption you would gain is halved.

blessings.name: Unpoisoned Blood
blessings.desc: Burn, poison, and corruption pools cannot harm you over time.

blessings.name: Mercy in the Circle
blessings.desc: Your Binding Seal restores 5 health for every enemy it captures.

blessings.name: Starfire Brand
blessings.desc: Your attacks set enemies burning with starfire.

blessings.name: Walk of Embers
blessings.desc: Your dash leaves a trail of flame that burns enemies.

blessings.name: Scattered Tongues
blessings.desc: Your crescent special splits into three flame bolts on impact.

blessings.name: Sight Within Fire
blessings.desc: Narrowly dodging an attack briefly slows the world around you.

forbidden.name: Tooth of the Devourer
forbidden.desc: Heal for 6% of damage you deal. Hunger answers hunger. (+20 Corruption)

forbidden.name: The Third Eye Opens
forbidden.desc: Your crescent special fires a second crescent. You see too much. (+25 Corruption)

duos.name: Verdict Pronounced
duos.desc: Word and sword agree. Marked enemies take more damage AND your strikes stagger harder.

duos.name: Shielded Mercy
duos.desc: The Prince guards; the Healer mends. Heal after each room, and deal more damage while wounded.

duos.name: Sword of Fire
duos.desc: The blade at the gate of Eden was a flaming sword. Your strikes burn, and bite deeper into iron.

duos.name: Word of Healing
duos.desc: Annunciation and balm. Your Binding Seal heals more, and Revelation builds faster.

duos.name: Tongues of Flame
duos.desc: The message divides into fire. Your crescent marks AND splits into three on impact.

duos.name: Cauterize
duos.desc: The wound is burned clean. Your dash leaves healing-fire, and no damage-over-time can touch you.

relics.name: Censer of Embers
relics.desc: A swinging coal from the Watchtower brazier. Attacks have a chance to burn — your strikes now always burn.

relics.name: Witness's Phylactery
relics.desc: Verses bound to the forehead. +25 Maximum Health.

relics.name: Bronze Greaves of the Runner
relics.desc: Cast before the flood, untouched by it. Dash recovers 25% faster.

relics.name: Lapis Tear
relics.desc: A drop of the upper waters. Revelation builds 35% faster and +10 Maximum Health.

relics.name: Whetstone of the First Altar
relics.desc: It has only ever sharpened consecrated edges. +15% damage.

relics.name: Cord of the Scapegoat
relics.desc: The crimson cord tied to the goat sent into the wilderness. +15 Maximum Health, and corruption you take is reduced.

relics.name: Length of the Binding Chain
relics.desc: A link of the chain Raphael used on Azazel. Binding an enemy heals you, and the bound yield more Revelation when they fall.

relics.name: Star-Chart of Uriel
relics.desc: The courses of the luminaries, drawn in a warm hand. Revelation builds 25% faster and your Ultimate charges faster.

relics.name: Shard of the First Anvil
relics.desc: Cold iron from the forge you broke. +25% damage against the armored, and +8% damage to everything.
